en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a catalog-style display of many small metal jewelry pieces (brooches, pendants, charms, chains). Each item is photographed against a dark background and labeled with a small number. German text on the image promotes the work of a goldsmith named W. Schwarz in Meissen, who is described as a royal Saxon purveyor to the court. Additional German text along the bottom explains that complete sample sheets in a certain size are available upon payment.
